verdict.rationale: GitHub runs a first-party Marketplace of apps from community and partners (github-docs-22, github-docs-35), pitched as a way to 'extend your stack with apps, actions, and AI models' (github-docs-10). The directory lists concrete third-party integrations such as Render, Lovable, Atlassian/Jira, Slack, Shopify and mobile CI/CD (github-intdir-1 through github-intdir-7). Missing for 10: documentation of the actual install and authorization flow, and independent or hands-on corroboration of installing apps.
